sentences.text: Flexomornis is an extinct genus of enantiornithean bird, a group within the class Reptilia.
The specific species name of this genus is howei.
Scientists Tykoski and Fiorillo formally described the genus Flexomornis in 2010.
The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — was found just 100 meters from the holotype of Ampelognathus coheni.
This animal lived between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago during the Cenomanian stage.
